description: Demolition of the brick wall, a new brick wall, fence and gates to be built with a maximum height of 1.8m
decision_conditions: The proposed boundary wall, piers, venetian style panels and gates would result in harm to the character and appearance of the street-scene and would be at odds with prevailing local character, thereby detrimental to the visual amenity and contrary to Havering Local Plan Policy 26 and the objectives of the Framework which at DP3 amongst other considerations requires proposals respond to their context and integrate with and enhance their surroundings.

Statement Required by Article 35 (2) of the Town and Country Planning (Development Management Procedure) (England) Order 2015: Consideration was given to seeking amendments, but given conflict with adopted planning policy, notification of intended refusal and the reason(s) for it was given to the agent in writing 26-08-2026
